verdict.rationale: Skyvern's SDK puts AI commands on top of Playwright, so developers can act, extract and validate in natural language and fall back to selectors when needed (docs-19, docs-5). It also maps visual elements to actions on sites it has never seen, positioned as a replacement for brittle Selenium scripts (gh-1, docs-13), which supports resilience to selector and layout changes. One hands-on report shows it missing a tab click and a popup on an unfamiliar site (comm-2), which lowers confidence in reliability but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: detailed API docs for individual click/type primitives on described elements, explicit evidence of resilience to selector or layout changes, and independent corroboration of reliable element targeting.
